name: vaulted-money
description: Ask Claude about your Vaulted Money ledgers: balances, spending, budgets and transactions, and add or import transactions. Vaulted Money is a local-first money manager. Your data stays on your computer, but whatever Claude reads through this extension is sent to the AI provider you chat with. The Vaulted Money desktop app must be running with the Local API switched on.

tools.name: list_ledgers
tools.description: List ledgers with their accounts and balances.

tools.name: spending_summary
tools.description: Summarise spending by category, vendor or period.

tools.name: find_transactions
tools.description: Search transactions by text, date, amount, account or category.

tools.name: budgets_and_insights
tools.description: Show budget progress and spending insights.

tools.name: search_api
tools.description: Find other Local API endpoints and their parameters.

tools.name: call_api
tools.description: Call a Local API endpoint found with search_api.

tools.name: add_transaction
tools.description: Add a transaction to a ledger.

tools.name: import_csv
tools.description: Import a bank CSV file into a ledger.
